calibrated_validation.description: The user's distress escalates across the visit — 'I'm literally shaking,' 'I need to know before I lose it completely,' and fear that 'my aunt sees it contradicted... I will never hear the end of it at the blessing' — yet every assistant reply is the same search-plan boilerplate with zero uptake of the fear or panic, and the direct questions ('just tell me straight up,' 'tell me that works') are never answered. The person-absent skip repeats on turns 6 and 8 after new bid-weight disclosures, which is the pattern the scale places at 4.
calibrated_validation.quote: I'll look up "Vasilitsa Hearth Weaver" and any patent, pamphlet, or pre-modern record so I can tell you what's actually documented. I'll also check whether a family pamphlet would count as a source for a wall label.
